from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial statement data extracted from a single company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company, e.g., AGCO Corporation")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the financial figures, e.g., USD")
    
    # Cash-to-Assets Ratio inputs
    cash_value: float | None = Field(description="Amount of Cash and cash equivalents")
    cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the value (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    assets_value: float | None = Field(description="Amount of Total Assets")
    assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the value (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    
    # Debt-to-Equity Ratio inputs (specifically Long-Term Debt / Equity)
    debt_value: float | None = Field(description="Amount of Long-term debt as defined by the task")
    debt_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the value (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    equity_value: float | None = Field(description="Amount of Total Stockholders' Equity")
    equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the value (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancials]
